# Week 1 discussion
### Load the libs
``` {r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(stars)
library(tmap)
```

### Download the data

``` {r}
ei_points <- st_read('weekly_discussions/data/week 1 discussion data/ei_points.gpkg') |> 
  filter(type == "volcano")
ei_elev <- read_stars('weekly_discussions/data/week 1 discussion data/ei_elev.tif') # use stars bc it is a raster
ei_borders <- st_read('weekly_discussions/data/week 1 discussion data/ei_border.gpkg')
ei_roads <- st_read('weekly_discussions/data/week 1 discussion data/ei_roads.gpkg')
ei_elev
```

### Create a map of the outline Rapa Nui using tm_shape() + tm_borders()

``` {r}
tm_shape(ei_borders) +
    tm_borders() +
    tm_layout(main.title = "Easter Island")
```

### Create a multiple-object map with tmap
Expand on your single-object map to create a map of Rapa Nui and…

…denote the island’s borders and continuous elevation
…denote the island’s volcanoes and roads
…play with the color palette and essential map elements

``` {r}
tm_shape(ei_elev) +
    tm_graticules() +
    tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "-rd_yl_gn"), col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Elevation (m asl)")) +
tm_shape(ei_borders) +
    tm_borders(col = "black") +
    tm_layout(main.title = "Easter Island") +
tm_shape(ei_roads) +
    tm_lines(col = "brown") +
tm_shape(ei_points) +
    tm_symbols(shape = 24,
        size = "elevation",
    col = "black",
    size.legend = tm_legend(title = "Volcanoes (m asl)"))


```


### Make it interactive

``` {r}
tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(ei_elev) +
    tm_graticules() +
    tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "-rd_yl_gn"), col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Elevation (m asl)")) +
tm_shape(ei_borders) +
    tm_borders(col = "black") +
    tm_layout(main.title = "Easter Island") +
tm_shape(ei_roads) +
    tm_lines(col = "brown") +
tm_shape(ei_points) +
    tm_symbols(shape = 24,
        size = "elevation",
    col = "black",
    size.legend = tm_legend(title = "Volcanoes (m asl)"))


```

Try it in ggplot

```{r}
ggplot(data = ei_borders) +
    geom_sf() +
    geom_stars(data = ei_elev) +
    scale_fill_distiller(name = "Elevation (m asl)", # legend title with units
                       palette = "RdYlGn",         # red-yellow-green palette (no need to reverse)
                       na.value = "lightblue") +
    geom_sf(data = ei_roads) +
    geom_sf(data = ei_points, 
    shape = 17, color = "sienna")
```
